# Boiler service

Yearly service log for the combi in the kitchen. I do electrics, not gas, so this is the one job I pay someone for every year. Gas Safe exists for a reason.

## The boiler

- Worcester Bosch Greenstar 30i ErP combi, wall hung in the kitchen next to the back door
- Installed June 2016 by the previous owners (Mr and Mrs Ashdown), serial 47-406-17 on the data badge
- Flue goes straight out the back wall, horizontal, terminal about 1.9m off the patio
- Warranty was 7 years, so ran out June 2023. Not paying for an extended plan, just servicing it

## Who services it

Ollie Brannigan, Gas Safe reg 581224, one-man band out of Southmead. Got his number off Kev at the wholesaler. Turns up when he says, explains what he's doing, doesn't try to upsell a new boiler every visit like the last lot (BristolHeat Direct, never again, they quoted £2,850 for a "recommended upgrade" in 2022 on a boiler that was 6 years old).

Ollie's rates:
- 2023 service: £85
- 2024 service: £95 (fair, fuel's gone up)
- call-out if it's a fault: £60 first hour

## What he actually does

Watched him the whole way through in Oct 2024, took notes:

1. Checks the gas pressure at the inlet test point, working pressure 20.4 mbar (fine, should be about 20)
2. Takes the case off, looks at the burner and the heat exchanger with a torch
3. Cleans the condensate trap. Ours had a fair bit of grey sludge in it, he said that's normal for 8 years
4. Flue gas analyser in the test port. Readings below
5. Checks the expansion vessel charge with the system drained down on the boiler side: 0.7 bar, topped to 1.0 bar with a foot pump
6. Visual on the pipework, the PRV discharge pipe, the fused spur
7. Writes it all up on a service record, emails the PDF the same evening

## Flue gas readings

| Year | CO ppm | CO2 % | Ratio |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2023 | 41 | 9.1 | 0.0045 |
| 2024 | 19 | 9.0 | 0.0021 |

He said anything under 0.004 ratio he's happy, and the 2023 one was borderline because the burner needed a clean. After the clean it dropped right down.

## Faults so far

### EA 227 in Jan 2024

Boiler locked out on a Sunday night with EA 227 flashing (flame not detected). Reset it twice, it ran for ten minutes then locked out again. Ollie came Monday, the condensate pipe outside had frozen solid where it runs along the wall to the gully. Poured warm (not boiling) water over it, worked straight away. He suggested lagging it and upsizing the outside run to 32mm, which I did myself the weekend after. £60 call-out, invoice OB-2401-117.

### Pressure creeping down

Spring 2024 the gauge would drop from 1.3 to about 0.9 bar over two weeks. Turned out to be a weeping valve on the back bedroom radiator, not the boiler. That's in [[Bleeding radiators]] since it got mixed up with that job.

## Settings I've landed on

- Heating flow temp knob at about 60°C, not maxed. Combi is condensing properly below roughly 55°C return
- Hot water at 50°C
- Pressure when cold: 1.2 bar. If it goes under 1.0 I top up with the filling loop under the boiler
- Thermostat side of it is in [[Smart thermostat install]]

## Paperwork

Service records are in the green folder in the drawer under the TV and scanned into the house folder. The contents insurer asked for the last service date when we had the leak claim, see [[Home contents claim]], so keep these.

Next service due: October 2025. Ollie said text him in September because he books up.
